text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e w-h-o-s-e a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y w-a-s n-o-t v-e-r-i-f-i-e-d, l-e-f-t f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d p-a-c-k-a-g-i-n-g a-n-d t-r-a-c-e a-b-i-l-i-t-y r-e-c-o-r-d-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y q-u-a-l-i-t-y c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n b-e-f-o-r-e u-s-e

2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r o-b-t-a-i-n-e-d c-o-o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n f-r-o-m e-m-p-l-o-y-e-e-d p-e-r-s-o-n-n-e-l t-o i-n-s-e-r-t i-n-v-a-l-i-d b-a-t-c-h i-d-e-n-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n-s, l-e-f-t i-r-r-e-g-u-l-a-r s-e-r-i-a-l i-z-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d d-u-a-l a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l f-o-r d-a-t-a a-l-t-e-r-a-t-i-o-n-s

3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e l-o-g-s t-o s-h-o-w a n-o-m-i-n-a-l c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n, l-e-f-t i-n-c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-t c-o-n-d-i-t-i-o-n m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g f-i-l-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n-s

4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d t-o r-o-u-t-e s-u-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-u-s p-h-a-r-m-a-c-e-u-t-i-c-a-l-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s, l-e-f-t t-r-a-c-e-a-b-l-e s-h-i-p-p-i-n-g d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-a-t-i-o-n, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d a-n-t-i-c-i-p-a-t-e-d p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l-s

5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-w-a-i-t-e-d a r-e-s-p-o-n-s-e f-r-o-m r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y b-o-d-i-e-s w-h-i-l-e a-c-c-e-l-e-r-a-t-i-n-g d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t a p-a-t-t-e-r-n o-f i-n-c-r-e-a-s-i-n-g u-r-g-e-n-c-y i-n c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e n-e-c-e-s-s-a-r-y a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l f-o-r t-r-a-c-e-a-b-i-l-i-t-y
